title: Poland Caught Between the Arms Bill and the Grocery Bill · 12 Sep
keywords: Poland, inflation, defense spending, NBP, NATO, EU fiscal policy, interest rates, cost of living, Polish economy, rearmament, European security, budget deficit
notes: Poland is navigating one of the sharpest fiscal dilemmas in the European Union, simultaneously running one of the continent's largest defense budgets while grappling with inflation that has drifted back above its central bank's target. The twin pressures are reshaping household finances, political debates, and Poland's broader role in European security. How Warsaw resolves this tension may offer a template — or a warning — for other member states facing similar trade-offs.
